content:
Mike: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — want to lock owners/timelines for the surge simulation we discussed.
Anika: I can own the multi-region routing checklist. Will validate failover priorities for EU->US and US->APAC.
Josh: I’ll take backups/restore runbook updates + verify point-in-time restore steps.
Lina: I’ll handle the CDN/DNS TTLs and sticky session fallback tests (affects session affinity).
Paul: I’ll coordinate the game-day schedule and run the runbook readthrough with on-call.
SRE-Bot: Reminder: postmortem action tracker updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-INC-2418 
Mike: Thanks — can we put concrete due dates? We want a dry-run before the end of next sprint.
Anika: Proposal: routing checklist due 2026-04-14, validation run 2026-04-20.
Josh: Backups/restore patch due 2026-04-12, full restore rehearsal 2026-04-22. I’ll add a small runbook snippet here for the restore sanity check:
```
# Restore sanity check (short form)
1) Promote replica in secondary region (pg_promote)
2) Switch application traffic to secondary route (route table id: rtb-prod-secondary)
3) Run smoke tests: /health, /login, sample-generation 5x
4) Validate data integrity (record counts, sample user checks)
```
Lina: DNS TTL changes: will prepare a plan to lower to 30s for game-day window and revert. Putting draft in the doc.
Paul: I’ll book two 90-min slots: one dry-run (weekday) and one full game-day (weekend). Prefer Apr 21 dry-run, Apr 25 weekend? thoughts?
Mike: Apr 21 dry-run works for the core team; Apr 25 might clash with product launch. Can we do Apr 26 instead?
Anika: Apr 26 OK for me.
Josh: Re: recurring incident pattern — we saw degraded KV-cache eviction during cross-region spikes. I’ll add an action to add cache-miss telemetry and an SLO alert. Owner: Josh. ETA 2026-04-10.
Lina: Also we should add a step in the runbook to clear local KV cache prior to failover to avoid stale pointers. Adding that now.
Mike: Good catch. Can we summarize the action items in this thread so I can add to the template? Short lines pls.
Anika: Action: Multi-region routing checklist -> Owner: Anika -> Due: 2026-04-14 -> Notes: verify route priorities, BGP weights, egress costs.
Josh: Action: Backups + restore playbook -> Owner: Josh -> Due: 2026-04-12 -> Notes: PITR verification, replica promotion, post-restore smoke tests.
Lina: Action: DNS & session fallback plan -> Owner: Lina -> Due: 2026-04-14 -> Notes: TTL to 30s, session affinity testcases.
Paul: Action: Game-day scheduling & runbook rehearsal -> Owner: Paul -> Due: 2026-04-09 -> Notes: lock attendees, reserve channels, incident commander rotation.
Josh: Action: Cache telemetry & eviction alert -> Owner: Josh -> Due: 2026-04-10 -> Notes: add histogram for eviction spike, alert at 5x baseline.
SRE-Bot: Action created in tracker: DR-2418-ROUTING, DR-2418-RESTORE, DR-2418-DNS, DR-2418-GAMEDAY, DR-2418-CACHE.
Mike: OK — I’ll convert these into the sprint ticket list. One last ask: please add one step each to the runbook that explicitly states "when traffic is routed to secondary region, scale read replicas to 2x baseline" — avoids capacity surprises.
Anika: Adding scaling note now.
Lina: Adding a small checklist item: run warmup traffic generator 5 minutes before cutover.
Paul: I’ll schedule a short pregame sync 30m before the dry-run with owners.
Mike: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers on resources (permissions, infra quotas), drop them here and I’ll escalate. :thumbsup:
Anika: Noted. I’ll ping infra for BGP weight change approvals today.
Josh: I’ll run a preliminary PITR test tomorrow and post results.
Lina: I’ll draft the DNS revert automation so we can flip TTLs back automatically.
Paul: Will post calendar invites and the runbook link by EOD.
SRE-Bot: Incident action status reminder scheduled for 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC (owners to submit progress).
Mike: Thanks team — closing this thread for now, will re-open with game-day notes after the dry-run.
